facts.fact: The ministers launched APIM digital services on 4 April 2025 letting investors create companies online through the 'Mes services' portal.
Company creation through the portal yields a commerce register entry, a tax registration and social security (CNSS) affiliation in a single procedure.

systems.platform: mobile app and portal (App Store, Play Store)
systems.tiers: sign-in verified through the Mon Identité app

MRT.note: Names an agenda numérique and an administration modernisation strategy without standing, text or period.

facts.fact: The government launched on 4 April 2025 the 'Mes services' portal and app with two services, online company creation and investment-code accreditation requests.

MRT.note: Mentions easier digital access for startups as a priority only; no law, label or fund.

facts.fact: Since 4 April 2025 a tax registration can be obtained through the APIM 'Mes services' portal as part of company creation.
The portal gives commerce register, tax registration and social security affiliation in one procedure at company creation.

MRT.note: States nothing about hubs, incubators or parks.
